minimal_escrow_rule_proposal.arm: Only after actual natural DONE, fresh matching PID-generation/PSS release witness, active feasible target and observed positive C margin already allocable by the old token rule. No pre-exit forecast, failure, external-only free, padding-only free or no-closure event can arm escrow.
minimal_escrow_rule_proposal.erosion: Legal fresh backfill may use unprotected headroom/25% share but cannot erase earmarked escrow merely by recording the claim-induced negative C. Physical RAM/CPU/disk gates still decide every launch; external pressure still pauses new admission without signals. Do not automatically top escrow up from unrelated later headroom movement.

minimal_escrow_rule_proposal.integration: If Main authorizes implementation, same-owner/same-state source-versioned operational accounting only, deepcopy-safe plain closure and true FrameUnavailable rollback; no scientific schema/spec/budget/controller change.
minimal_escrow_rule_proposal.negative: A definitive failed strict/negative or failed required acceptance removes the provisional escrow without creating performance credit. Preserve the original negative/identity and all raw evidence.
minimal_escrow_rule_proposal.reserve: Earmark75% of the realized positive-release amount as provisional target escrow before backfill. Expose effective virtual fence=min(target cost, existing strict protected + pending escrow). Do not add escrow to physical RAM predictions/claims or alter candidate full costs.
minimal_escrow_rule_proposal.success: On accepted full strict + archive + native restore for the same natural generation, transfer escrow to strict protected credit once with no increase of the effective fence, then mark the generation consumed for release accounting.
minimal_escrow_rule_proposal.target_lifecycle: Retain existing single-target, own-drain feasibility, full-claim backing/virtual-fence release and observed-target reset behavior. No retroactive escrow for the already-eroded historical three episodes.
minimal_escrow_rule_proposal.unknown: Unknown, missing or unresolved archive/strict outcomes stay visibly provisional and earn no strict credit; do not fabricate failure or PASS, refund/retry identity, kill or pause models. Operational alert/recovery may be needed rather than silent escrow release.
